title: Tailwind latency observatory: model+route p50/p95/p99 with streaming vs non-streaming cohorts
creator: Emily Chen
description: Objective: Build a focused observability board (the 'Tailwind Latency Observatory') that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency for each model and customer route, with explicit streaming vs non-streaming cohorting and trace links for rapid RCA. This ticket covers metrics pipeline adjustments, tracing hook insertion points in the serving runtime, dashboard panels, and the rollout plan.
background: Our existing latency boards show model/route percentiles but lack consistent streaming/non-streaming segmentation and easy jump-to-trace links for outliers. Engineering and SREs spend extra time reconstructing whether delays are caused by KV cache misses, batching, or network tails. This work ties together: (1) telemetry producers in the runtime, (2) metrics/log pipeline transforms to attach io_mode tags, and (3) dashboard panels that make cohort comparisons obvious.
design_decisions: Emit redwood.latency_ms histogram with labels: model, route, io_mode (streaming|sync), request_shape, kv_cache_hit (true|false), model_variant
Add a small sampling trace for slow requests (p95+) with trace_id exported to the same observability backend; include a stable trace_url field in metrics events
Do percentile calculation in the metrics backend (ClickHouse/Prometheus hybrid) to keep dashboard queries fast; store p50/p95/p99 as precomputed aggregates for last-1h and last-24h

Dashboard will present a 2x2 panel matrix: rows=model family (top 5 by traffic), columns=route; each panel shows streaming vs non-streaming stacked percentiles and a 'jump to trace' link on outlier buckets
acceptance_criteria: New histogram metric redwood.latency_ms emitted by runtime with required labels in canary cluster
Metrics pipeline transforms io_mode tag consistently for both streaming websocket and sync HTTP paths
Dashboard contains model+route panels with p50/p95/p99 lines and explicit streaming vs non-streaming breakdowns
Clicking 'jump to trace' on a p95+ series opens a link to a captured trace with context (kv_cache_hit, batch_size, node_id, model_variant)
Automated alert: route-level p95 exceeds SLA threshold for 5m triggers a PagerDuty rule (configurable per-customer)
Load test verification: under synthetic traffic up to 2x normal peak, percentile computation remains <500ms for dashboard queries
implementation_notes: Runtime changes: add hook at ServePathHandler to annotate each request with io_mode and to emit a latency timing event to the telemetry client. If response is streaming, send periodic progress marks (first_byte, mid_stream_chunk, final_token) so streaming latency distribution captures first-byte and completion times. Sampling: trace full spans for requests above configured latency threshold (default p95 heuristic) and 0.1% random sampling for cold-start analysis.
telemetry_queries_and_panels: Panel A - ModelRoutePercentiles: SELECT quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95, quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99 FROM metrics WHERE time > now() - 1h GROUP BY model, route, io_mode
Panel B - StreamingVsSyncComparison: time series with two lines per percentile: percentile(streaming) vs percentile(sync) for selected model+route
Panel C - Tail Explorer: histogram heatmap of latency_ms with overlays for kv_cache_hit=false to highlight cache miss tails
Panel D - Trace Links Table: top 50 slow traces for selected window with prebuilt trace_url and context columns (batch_size, node_id, model_variant, request_shape)
Alert Query: p95(route) > 450ms for 5m -> send alert with recent top-10 trace_urls
log_pipeline_changes: Add io_mode enrichment step in the metrics/log transform service: if request proto indicates streaming frames (ws or server-sent events), set io_mode=streaming; otherwise io_mode=sync. Also forward kv_cache_hit and batch_size tags into metric events. Ensure upstream samplers and drop rules preserve these fields.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Deploy telemetry patch to canary cluster (5% traffic) and send metrics to a sandbox metrics dataset. Validate labels and sample traces (1 day)
Phase 2 (metric pipeline): Enable enrichment in ingestion for beta dataset and create precomputed aggregates for p50/p95/p99 over 1h and 24h windows
Phase 3 (dashboard): Deploy Tailwind dashboard in staging; run shared runbook walkthrough with SRE and PM
Phase 4 (prod): Gradual ramp to 100% over 3 days; activate alerts and retire temporary instrumentation flags
qa_plan: 1) Unit tests for runtime label emission. 2) Integration test: synthetic streaming and sync workloads that assert io_mode label presence and percentile values. 3) End-to-end validation by running load generator for two model families and verifying dashboard queries return expected cohort splits. 4) Manual trace inspection to ensure jump-to-trace context includes kv_cache_hit and batch info.
risks_and_mitigations: Increased metric cardinality: mitigate by limiting model variants surfaced by default to top 10 by traffic and collapsing rare routes into 'other' buckets
Trace storage explosion: use latency-based sampling and cap retained full traces per route per hour
Dashboard query performance: precompute percentile aggregates and cache tile results for 1 minute
dependencies_notes: Depends on ENG-4820 for route tagging consistency and ENG-96321 for trace ingestion scaling. Will open a small PR in runtime repo and a companion PR in telemetry transforms. Coordinate with SRE to update sampling config.
